items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: Some by Al Cohn, some by Ernie Wilkins.

ctx.x: Well you and I have experienced some things with the Basie tour, night after night after night with them.

Yes. Listening to Sarah Vaughan and Jimmie Jones and Richard Davis and Roy Haynes with the Basie band playing those wonderful charts. Some by Al Cohn, some by Ernie Wilkins. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
